_comment: Example Claude Code settings for an economics research project. Place at .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json (global). Two mechanisms: permission rules (deny the agent READING confidential paths: the agent never sees the content, so it is never sent to the API) and hooks (shell commands that run around tool calls; the PreToolUse hook blocks EDITS under data/raw/, protecting integrity). Hooks receive the tool input as JSON on stdin; file_path arrives as an ABSOLUTE path, hence the (^|/) in the patterns. Needs jq; the PostToolUse hooks also need ruff and latexmk (delete the ones you do not want). See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks-guide and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions

permissions._comment: Deny rules are checked before any hook runs. Read(...) stops the agent from opening the files; the Bash rules stop the obvious shell detours. Not airtight against every shell command: restricted data belongs on a machine the agent does not run on.

PostToolUse._comment: Recompile LaTeX whenever Claude edits a .tex file in paper/.

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -E '(^|/)paper/[^/]*\.tex$' | xargs -r -I{} sh -c 'cd paper && latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > .latexmk.log 2>&1 || echo "latexmk failed, see paper/.latexmk.log"'

PostToolUse._comment: Run ruff on every Python file Claude writes or edits.

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -E '\.py$' | xargs -r ruff check --fix

PostToolUse._comment: Append every file Claude touched to an audit log. Note: only logs file paths; full Bash commands are deliberately NOT captured to avoid leaking secrets (API keys in env vars, tokens in URLs, etc.) into .claude/audit.log.

PreToolUse._comment: Block edits to data/raw/ at the system level. Exit code 2 blocks the tool call and shows stderr to Claude as the reason; the JSON form (hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision = deny) does the same with more control.

hooks.command: jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // "") | test("(^|/)data/raw/")' > /dev/null && { echo 'data/raw/ is read-only per CLAUDE.md' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
